stage: locally specified before core-test predictions; computational study, seed 17
domain: Eligible, deterministic non-overlapping patches; same common label/SAR/optical support for all primary comparisons
review_cost: Valid geodesic area in each whole unit; physical time is not inferred
primary_endpoint: Residual false-negative inundation area after idealized correction within reviewed units
required_companion_endpoint: Residual false-positive area; improvements in missed area are assessed alongside false-alarm burden

tradeoff_checks.interpretation: Transparent area-cost sensitivity scenarios, not measured economic or human harm

review_assumption: Perfect correction inside selected units; not measured human accuracy or time saved
unit_selection: Descending score with stable ties; choose whole units that fit remaining area budget
oracle_reference: True FN-density ranking under the same whole-unit rule; not an optimal variable-cost knapsack claim
primary_comparisons: Value routing versus fusion and ordinary routing under the same entropy review policy
Learned omission risk versus entropy, probability proxy and unrestricted stacking risk on the same value-routed map
Value routing plus omission head versus fusion plus a matched omission head

multiplicity.method: Simultaneous 95% bootstrap bands using the maximum standardized centered deviation across six paired contrasts and both residual FN/FP endpoints
multiplicity.family: Twelve estimates within each region at the primary 10% budget and 10 km spatial blocks
multiplicity.other_intervals: Pointwise descriptive intervals; do not select a main claim by screening all secondary contrasts or block sizes

foundation_controls: TerraMind tiny adapted to RGB + new GF3 and NIR inputs
foundation_comparison_scope: Different-capacity architecture control; not a parameter-matched comparison or a claim that tiny is the strongest TerraMind version
ensemble_control: Three fusion members trained with fixed seeds 17, 29 and 43; mean probability map, variance and mutual-information review scores
targeted_uncertainty_control: Area-mean entropy restricted to predicted-negative pixels, alongside the stronger probability-based omission proxy
calibration_controls: Positive temperature fitted to development event-held-out probabilities; raw and calibrated results both retained

spatial_uncertainty.scope: Spatial block composition uncertainty within each observed region; not independent-event replication
spatial_uncertainty.review_interval_scope: Conditional on the fixed model and selected review units on the observed map

binned_probability_metrics.label: Area-weighted binned approximation; IoU, Brier, NLL and omission areas remain pixel-exact

guardrails: No checkpoint, threshold, architecture or policy selection using core-test labels
Show both supportive and contrary hypothesis outcomes
No population, casualty, forecast lead-time or realized labor-saving claims from these data

operating_point_controls.reference: Fusion at probability 0.5 on sampled area-weighted development OOF predictions
operating_point_controls.test_rule: Apply these fixed raw-probability thresholds unchanged; report actual test FN/FP and rates; no matching on test labels
operating_point_controls.scope: Secondary classification controls; learned review heads remain tied to the original 0.5 decision

router_mechanism_diagnostics.predicted_value: Area-mean learned Brier-loss improvement, saved during inference without test labels
router_mechanism_diagnostics.observed_value: Area-mean SAR Brier loss minus fusion Brier loss
router_mechanism_diagnostics.scope: Descriptive held-out unit-level value estimation; not a causal effect of the sensor

targeted_ensemble_controls: Report both full-unit ensemble variance/mutual information and their restriction to predicted-negative pixels for each evaluated map
